games.name: Orangutag! 🦧
games.desc:
We are working on a new game called "Monke Tag" which will be the sequel to Orangutag.

FAQ:
Q: Will Orangutag still be updated?
A: Only for bug updates, but no new content updates.

Q: When will Monke Tag be released?
A: We have no release date as of now. If we do we will update this page to let you know :) For now we're still developing the game.

Q: Will Monke Tag be different than Orangutag?
A: Yes, so far they are absolutely nothing alike and Monke Tag will have more unique features.

Q: What can I expect from Monke Tag?
A: You can expect things like an Item Shop, Accessories, Game Modes, and we plan on adding much more!
(When we say "Accessories" we're not talking about Avatar/Roblox Accessories)

games.name: Clover City
games.desc:
Join the group for a permanent glowstick item!

Warning: This game is difficult.

Account must be at least 2 weeks old to play!

💸You can get money by robbing Safes, killing NPCs or getting a job.
💥Most small structures like the streetlights, fire hydrants, and trees can be damaged with any gun or melee.
🪓You can gather wood from the fallen trees and use to barricade certain places
🏠Customize and build your own home
💪Get bigger or smaller at the gym
🕵Explore and discover secrets

Basic Controls:
Hold down to charge your melee attacks.  Max damage when the fist glows.
E, Stomp | G, Carry | Q Mouselock (must have mouselock active)
F, Block | Ctrl, Crouch | Shift, Run

Green bar is your health.  Yellow bar is your stamina.
💫Means you're knocked out, stomping someone knocked out will damage them
⚠️Means you're down, stomping someone down will kill them
☠️Means you're dead

Game similar to Da Hood, Criminality and aspects of Ohio.
